title: Radiant numbers normalized to ×2
notes: Issue #1220 normalizes Radiant numbers to ×2 across 22 cards and tokens. Numbers on the Radiant face: core-005 Stockpile draws 4, was 5, and heals 4, was 5; core-028 Knockoff Temu Glowy Jelly Bean makes 4 Radiant, was 5; core-044 True Strike deals 8, was 9; core-047 Fig of Life heals 40, was 50; classic-031 Cookie Guild recruits 2, was 3; classic-061 Plague Bringer Goliath draws 2, was 3; classicplus-028 Nuestro hogar, nuestras tumbas heals 6, was 8; classicplus-038 Solarius has Spell Damage +4, was +5; classicplus-038-1 Solarius Prime has Spell Damage +6, was +7; meditative-035 RCTA (CN) gives +4/+4, was +5/+5; meditative-039-3 Dud deals 4, was 5; meditative-092 Unan has Armor 6, was 7; meditative-097-2 Wishing Well has 10% chance, was 12%; core-004 Gary the Gambler flips 10 coins, was 7, at +1/+1 a side, was +2/+2; core-024 Efficiency Dividend deals X damage, was X+1, and Radiant deals 2X damage, was 2X+1; classic-063 Crop Dusting places 2 counters, was 3, and draws 2, was 3; classicplus-065-2 Normal Grape draws 2, was 4; meditative-007 Introspection heals 6, was 8; meditative-096 Meditative Journey exiles up to 4 cards, was 5; meditative-097-6 University Buffs 4 times, was 5; meditativeplus-009 Magic Amplifier has Spell Damage +4, was +5; meditativeplus-017 Dogpile deals 4, was 5. Seven cards ship under older claims: core-004, classicplus-065-2, meditative-007 and meditative-096 under v0.3.8; meditative-097-6 under v0.3.9; core-024 and classic-063 under v0.3.10. This note's player lines describe those seven too. The M+ cards are unshipped (R1420). No script is kept (R767000).

player.title: Radiant numbers set at double
balance: Radiant Stockpile draws 4 and heals 4, down from 5 and 5.
Radiant Knockoff Temu Glowy Jelly Bean makes 4 random cards among your deck, hand and board Radiant, down from 5.
Radiant True Strike deals 8 damage, down from 9.
Radiant Fig of Life heals your hero 40, down from 50.
Radiant Cookie Guild recruits 2 Units, down from 3.
Radiant Plague Bringer Goliath draws 2 cards, down from 3.
Radiant Crop Dusting places 2 Plague Counters and draws 2 cards, down from 3 each.
Radiant Nuestro hogar, nuestras tumbas heals your hero 6, down from 8.
Radiant Solarius has Spell Damage +4, down from +5.
Radiant Solarius Prime has Spell Damage +6, down from +7.
Radiant Normal Grape draws 2 cards, down from 4.
Radiant Introspection heals your hero and Units 6, down from 8.
Radiant RCTA (CN) gives a non-CN permanent +4/+4, down from +5/+5.
Radiant Dud deals 4 damage, down from 5.
Radiant Unan has Armor 6, down from 7.
Radiant Meditative Journey chooses up to 4 cards in your hand, down from 5.
Radiant Wishing Well has a 10% chance, the same as its normal version, down from 12%. It keeps Lucky 1.
Radiant University Buffs each of your other permanents 4 times, down from 5.
changes: Efficiency Dividend's damage choice deals X damage, and 2X on its Radiant version, where it dealt X+1 and 2X+1.
Radiant Gary the Gambler flips 10 coins and gains +1 Attack per heads and +1 Health per tails, where it flipped 7 at +2 each.
